Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for J.C. Bose University Research Assistant/Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the J.C. Bose University recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Research Assistant/Project Fellow. This is a contractual position within the university.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant/Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant/Project Fellow position as per the official notification released by J.C. Bose University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc or M.Tech degree in Microbiology or Biotechnology with a minimum of 55% marks or an equivalent grade from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant/Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month for this contractual role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Research Assistant/Project Fellow post is scheduled to be held on 18 September 2026. Candidates should be present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the J.C. Bose University located?
faq.answer: J.C. Bose University of Science and Technology is located in Faridabad, Haryana. Candidates should confirm the exact interview venue from the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Assistant/Project Fellow position is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.
